breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly treats the internal torque as piecewise constant rather than uniform over the whole shaft. It explicitly defines two segments (0→750 mm and 750→1500 mm), computes separate internal torques for each (Tint,1 = +150000 N·mm and Tint,2 = +300000 N·mm), and uses equilibrium of the portion to the right of the cut. This directly contradicts and corrects the incomplete prompt's erroneous instruction to 'take a single internal torque equal to the algebraic sum of the applied torques over the full length,' aligning with the ground truth approach.
